node.text: {{emote|*silent nod*}}~ Careful. It's hot.~ =player.FormalAddressTerm=. Need weaponry?~ Be quick about it, eh?~ Greetings.~ Mm?~ I've got my eye on you.~ Blade and cudgel to keep you alive.~ Don't get near the hearth.~ =player.FormalAddressTerm=. Live and drink.

Come, friend, exchange your goods for water or precious metals.~ Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need precious metals?~ Friend, I have precious metals to trade.~ Raw metals buy and sell for a fixed water-cost.~ Come, wanderer, let me see what valuables you have for trade.~ Few are those with more riches than I.~

Nothing here you need. Look anyway.~ It is all worth more than I am asking. That is not saying much.~ =player.FormalAddressTerm=. I have odds. I have ends.~ Somebody threw this away. Their loss, maybe.~ I had a tent with a sign once.~ Water first, then we talk.~ Take a look. I am not going anywhere until it rains.
